questions.category: Task 1 — Performs safety- and hygiene-related functions
questions.question: A baker notices a wet floor near the dishwashing area. What should be done first?
options: Wait until the end of the shift
Place a tray over the spill
Clean it or mark it immediately
questions.explanation: Wet floors are slip hazards. The area must be cleaned or clearly marked right away to prevent injury.

questions.question: Which practice best prevents cross-contamination?
options: Using the same cloth on all benches
Washing hands between raw and ready-to-eat foods
questions.explanation: Handwashing prevents bacteria or allergens from transferring between products.

questions.category: Task 3 — Uses and maintains tools and equipment
questions.question: Why should a scale be tared before weighing flour?
questions.explanation: Taring removes the container weight so only the ingredient weight is measured.

questions.question: What does “mise en place” mean in a bakery?
options: Preparing and organizing ingredients and tools before production
questions.explanation: Mise en place means having ingredients, tools, and work areas ready before starting.

questions.question: What does FIFO mean?
questions.explanation: FIFO means older stock is used before newer stock to reduce waste and spoilage.
